decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The works hereby approved shall not be commenced until drawings of an appropriate scale (eg 1:20) showing details of replacement windows, including joinery details and the relationship of the frames to the openings have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The works shall then be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of a new fence to front elevation, replacement of top floor window with sash window to the front, demolition of existing rear external broken stairway and erection of a single-storey rear extension incorporating internal alterations to house (Listed Building Consent).
